summary: Iteration 3 testing — 22/22 backend tests PASSED (100%). Frontend ~70%: typewriter reveal, disclaimer, follow-ups, high-risk badge+banner, admin sidebar (5 items), Analytics (4 tiles+4 blocks), Feedback queue all WORK. THREE critical frontend bugs found: (1) DocumentsPage has runtime error 'replacingDoc is not defined' that crashes the entire /admin/documents route, (2) new-user onboarding redirect is broken (lands on /chat instead of /onboarding despite backend correctly returning needs_onboarding=true), (3) feedback POSTs from chat UI return 404 because frontend uses client-side tempAsstId rather than the server's real message_id.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'ReferenceError: replacingDoc is not defined'. The component uses `replacingDoc` and `setReplacingDoc` (lines 71, 76, 78, 90, 233, 238, 247) but the useState declaration was never added. The page renders Uncaught runtime errors overlay and cannot be used at all. This blocks: expiry/jurisdiction upload fields validation, Replace button feature, EXPIRED badge verification.

After registering a brand-new user (backend correctly returns needs_onboarding=true and persists it — backend test PASSED), the frontend navigates to /chat instead of /onboarding. The post-register/login flow is not honoring the needs_onboarding flag from the auth response. Existing admin login correctly goes to /admin/stats so admin path is fine.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend POSTs /api/feedback/{message_id} using a client-generated tempAsstId (ChatPage.jsx line 103 sets `message_id: tempAsstId`). The server-side chat message has a different DB id, so all feedback calls return 404 and the toast shows 'Couldn't save feedback'. The SSE 'done' handler never swaps tempAsstId for the server's real message_id. Backend feedback API works correctly when called with a real message_id (verified by 8 backend tests).

action_items: FIX DocumentsPage.jsx — add `const [replacingDoc, setReplacingDoc] = useState(null);` near the other useState hooks (around line 31). Without this the entire /admin/documents page crashes.

FIX onboarding redirect — after register/login, if the auth response has needs_onboarding=true, navigate to /onboarding rather than /chat. Check src/pages/LoginPage.jsx and src/lib/auth-context.js post-auth navigation logic.

FIX feedback message_id mismatch — when the SSE 'done' event arrives with the server-issued message_id, ChatPage.jsx must replace the assistant row's tempAsstId with the real id (e.g. setMessages prev => prev.map(m => m.message_id===tempAsstId ? {...m, message_id: data.message_id} : m)). Otherwise feedback POSTs always 404.

After fixes, re-test the Documents page upload dialog (Expiry Date + Jurisdiction fields), Replace button + 'Replacing X' banner, and EXPIRED status badge — none of these could be verified due to the page crash.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentsPage.jsx: missing useState for replacingDoc — clear oversight; the entire feature shipped non-functional.
ChatPage.jsx: message_id should be the server's authoritative id once available. Using tempAsstId everywhere downstream (feedback, copy reference) is brittle.
Onboarding routing: the auth flow does not centralise the needs_onboarding check; both LoginPage and AuthProvider need to consult this flag before deciding the post-auth route.

Good: All backend routes (users, feedback, analytics, documents supersede/expiry, admin stats) work correctly end-to-end. SSRF regression holds. Analytics 403 on non-superadmin works. SSE 'done' event correctly carries suggested_followups + is_high_risk.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the 3 frontend bugs, re-run the Playwright flow paying special attention to: (1) /admin/documents page should not show 'replacingDoc is not defined', upload dialog should expose Expiry Date + Jurisdiction (both already have correct data-testid), Replace icon button (ArrowsLeftRight) should open dialog with 'Replacing X' banner. (2) Register a NEW user with unique email; verify it lands on /onboarding (data-testid=onboarding-page). (3) Send any chat, then click thumbs-down — toast should say 'Feedback saved' (not 'Couldn't save feedback') and the feedback row should appear in /admin/feedback. Use Radix Select interactions with force=True and 200ms wait after open. Backend testfile /app/backend/tests/test_ehs_rag_iteration3.py is the regression baseline.

rca_of_the_issue.DocumentsPage_crash: DocumentsPage.jsx references `replacingDoc` and `setReplacingDoc` in 6 places (set inside `replace(doc)` handler at line 90 and reset in upload submit at line 78, plus 4 read-sites for the conditional banner/button labels), but the corresponding `const [replacingDoc, setReplacingDoc] = useState(null);` line was never added near the other useState calls (lines 29-35). React throws ReferenceError at first render. Fix: add the missing useState line.
rca_of_the_issue.Onboarding_redirect: Backend register/login both return needs_onboarding correctly (verified via backend test_new_user_needs_onboarding PASS, /api/users/me PATCH PASS). The frontend navigates to /chat unconditionally after successful auth. The auth context / LoginPage post-auth navigation must consult user.needs_onboarding and route to /onboarding when true (and only to /chat or /admin/stats otherwise).
rca_of_the_issue.Feedback_404: ChatPage.jsx line 103 sets the assistant message's `message_id` to the client-generated `tempAsstId`. The SSE 'done' event from /api/chat/stream returns the server-issued message_id, but the handler does not swap tempAsstId for it. So when the user clicks thumbs-down, POST /api/feedback/{tempAsstId} hits the backend which can't find a chat_messages row with that id and returns 404 → 'Couldn't save feedback' toast. Fix: on SSE 'done', map prev messages to replace tempAsstId with data.message_id.
